H_protocol: H1 literal source-plane trait-compatible events; H2 actual disposition amplification with intensity-transfer limits; H3 actual behavior too dependent on a local punchline to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Magic, false claims, stage performance, nested fiction and survival are not automatic H3/H4. No category quota.
L_protocol: L0 portable propositions; L1 materially important wording/rhythm/tone; L2 pragmatic/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction or annotation. Standard ruby, gaiji and idioms do not by themselves require L3.

records.whole_selected_premise: A grand otherworld arrival degenerates into demands for a redo overheard by a narrator who thinks the speakers may be drunk.
records.L_rationale: The demanded redo invokes a prior choice whose dissatisfaction the listener lacks, producing an explicit uptake gap.
records.H_rationale: The pair really argue and Megumin really misclassifies their situation.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Reader familiarity is not Megumin’s knowledge, and the requested redo is not performed.

records.whole_selected_premise: The ambitious traveler judges novice parties badly equipped while one such group deliberately spends spare earnings on celebration.
records.L_rationale: Practical equipment criticism yields to a bounded once-in-a-while concession within the observed group.
records.H_rationale: Different actors actually value current shared pleasure and future equipment differently.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No universal novice incompetence or guaranteed short Axel stay; later reversal remains separate.

records.whole_selected_premise: A gifted adventurer needs a carrier, while the supposedly simple rival wants conversation, shared meals and ordinary company.
records.L_rationale: The invitation is accepted because invitations are rare; the narrator’s functional party account does not exhaust the recipient’s aims.
records.H_rationale: Both actual one-cast dependence and Yunyun’s independent wish for company are real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No automatic willingness to bear every future burden or an already formed permanent party.

records.whole_selected_premise: The long-sought Explosion lead is postponed until the seeker can appear established, while the novice guild greeting loses its audience.
records.L_rationale: A desired recognition scene is deferred for self-presentation, then a conspicuous entrance meets an empty room.
records.H_rationale: A received shop lead, hesitation and staged entrance are literal.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The woman’s identity is not locally verified and a performed introduction does not confer fame.

records.whole_selected_premise: Public stat appraisal is delayed to maximize witnesses, then another class’s higher mana initially spoils the genius display.
records.L_rationale: The narrator explicitly wants this reaction; the class distinction selectively neutralizes her comparison.
records.H_rationale: Audience management and high actual stats coexist with someone else’s higher mana.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Exceptional output is not control or general occupational superiority. The Axis archpriest clue is already received here.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real-name introduction becomes a threat to hear objections, while the observer withholds help from a friend as supposed training.
records.L_rationale: Polite naming shifts into challenge, and training frames a deliberate refusal of available social assistance.
records.H_rationale: Megumin actually chooses a small party and leaves Yunyun outside despite an extra-member opening.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No claim that social inhibition is improved by this choice or that the friend requested this lesson.

records.whole_selected_premise: A food-named pest is much larger and harder than expected, and the specialist’s successful extermination also destroys crops and throws her partners.
records.L_rationale: Misleading expected prey size and overlarge area effect are portable practical mismatches.
records.H_rationale: Rize and Raina fight; Megumin requests separation but the actual radius still catches allies and trees.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Target destruction is not an independently prepared safe operation or a harmless visual gag.

records.whole_selected_premise: Praise for overwhelming power becomes tactful exclusion when the same caster cannot supply intact meat or repeat ordinary work.
records.L_rationale: The group-cannot-offer-your-stage wording saves the recruit’s face while refusing the actual task mismatch.
records.H_rationale: One-spell disclosure, private consultation and Megumin’s own compensation payment have material consequences.
records.eligibility_and_limits: She pays because others should not bear her damage; private words she cannot hear are not supplied as fact.

records.whole_selected_premise: A companionship advertisement attracts an older-looking self-declared thirteen-year-old, while fields of fish defeat another worker’s assumptions.
records.L_rationale: Age claims and the promise of conversation have unequal credibility; the fish exchange becomes an insult because the work premise is not shared.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun reports the visitor and meal; the unknown working pair actually lose this job.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Reported meeting detail is not a second directly witnessed scene; no automatic proof of the visitor’s age or the fish worker’s deliberate mockery.

records.whole_selected_premise: The lonely applicant relaxes practical partner requirements while preserving the very company she wants, and her friend again calls nonhelp training.
records.L_rationale: Wrong-direction compromise evaluates the order of concessions rather than showing that the core wish vanished.
records.H_rationale: Revised notice and solitary board play remain actual choices under social difficulty.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No inference that every possible group refused her or that accepting any admirer is a good substitute.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposedly universally advanced Crimson recruit genuinely cannot cast among allies; the supposedly lesser party supplies frontliners and healing.
records.L_rationale: Actual geometry and provider roles explain the refusal without a Japanese lexical hinge.
records.H_rationale: Her no-cast judgment is real and other members do useful work.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Current restraint does not cancel later unsafe casts; no advanced spell is learned from reputation.

records.whole_selected_premise: The grand caster cannot hit low flying nuisances, then a week-long urine stain turns practical incapacity into a wildly amplified extermination demand.
records.L_rationale: The extermination wording and escalation after the smell disclosure materially intensify the written response.
records.H_rationale: Actual ineffective staff swinging and the need for physical restraint amplify wounded pride and disgust.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not export this comic intensity as a stable genocidal policy; the stain, incapacity and restraint are still literal.

records.whole_selected_premise: A request for a wide clear site is answered by a giant slime opportunity, but the only other spell user’s distance warning is still not enough to protect the group.
records.L_rationale: Target scale, distance, food supply and explosive radius explain the effect without a special form dependency.
records.H_rationale: Target elimination, knocked-down allies and fallen trees are actual; Megumin again resolves to use more distance next time.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The warning precedes firing. No retrospective friendly clearance, prepared recovery or ordinary own-technique failure under a full safe setup.

records.whole_selected_premise: A triumphant reward drink leads to an honest limitation disclosure, a genuine future leveling offer, an instant build refusal and painful doubt about being wanted.
records.L_rationale: The offer explicitly need not be immediate; her categorical reply is followed by exclusion and private self-questioning.
records.H_rationale: Useful power, accepted noncontribution, offered assistance, refusal and grief all coexist.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No invented current-unused-point floor. Meaningful conflict is not identical to buying a skill or changing policy.

records.whole_selected_premise: A hoped-for recruiter is merely the familiar rival, whose game rematch relies on a one-per-day Explosion rule.
records.L_rationale: The rapid recruitment speech and stop-calling-me-lonely correction reveal actual desired recognition before a procedural rematch.
records.H_rationale: They actually play and the board has its own declared rules.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A flipped game board is not a real Explosion cast, a universal world rule or automatic nonliteral behavioral license.

records.whole_selected_premise: A search for stronger suitable partners ends beside a banana act that attracts customers only after its stock has vanished.
records.L_rationale: Separate-selling-stock-from-disappearing-stock is a belated task distinction that the employer will not accommodate.
records.H_rationale: Megumin seeks a different role fit and the workers are actually fired.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The disappearance mechanism is unshown, and the narrator’s consolation is not proof her own recruitment is solved.

records.whole_selected_premise: A depleted newcomer calmly announces recurrent gate explosions while the guard asks what the unexplained blasts are for.
records.L_rationale: A courteous introductory formula treats repetition as routine without answering the recipient’s actual objection.
records.H_rationale: A cast and guard-assisted recovery have already occurred.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The one-week trial-party summary is aggregate narration, not many independently displayed cast trials.

records.whole_selected_premise: The friend’s careful card pyramid is deliberately sabotaged through a cat, then cat praise tries to redirect an explicit apology demand.
records.L_rationale: The cat-did-it excuse conflicts with the narrator’s actual placement and the recipient’s direct demand.
records.H_rationale: Megumin authors the destruction and Yunyun objects.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No pet intention, blanket friendship assent or repair is inferred from the deflection.

records.whole_selected_premise: A harassment scene is first dismissed as guild initiation, then sought as entertainment until the friend blocks the spectator’s view.
records.L_rationale: The narrator’s reason for disengaging changes when the same encounter offers spectacle; the loser misuses choose-opponents advice.
records.H_rationale: Harassment, refusal to intervene and the later weaker-victim plan are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The offscreen duel result is the thug’s report, and defeat does not produce an ethical reform.

records.whole_selected_premise: Literal obedience to monsters-only blasting creates a frog crater and real repair work, while civil wages offer another pair an equipment route.
records.L_rationale: The guard explains the purpose behind the rule and the worker argues against quitting after one day.
records.H_rationale: Crater labor and the specialist’s distant immobility risk are real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Land-leveling demand suggests the local consequence loop; do not invent every unseen employer or completed future repair.

records.whole_selected_premise: A feared applicant forces access to a notice, hears an actual safety reputation and tries an indoor chant despite having no mana.
records.L_rationale: Polite request becomes command and art-discrimination suspicion is explicitly corrected to dangerous-user reputation.
records.H_rationale: Amplified reputation sensitivity recruits an actual attempted indoor escalation and physical restraint.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed indoor Explosion; legal warning and social consequences remain literal. The insult is not automatically explicit denigration of Explosion as art.

records.whole_selected_premise: A marriage pretext slides into dating despite the young listener’s objections, and a socially lonely person admits even a cult pitch would provide conversation.
records.L_rationale: The listener names the changed purpose and limited willingness; Megumin’s police threat terminates the pressure.
records.H_rationale: Requests, reluctance, intervention and discarded recruitment paper are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The claimed sick mother is unverified, and limited concession under pressure does not grant broad consent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A temporary party offer exposes the very important earlier resolve that the proposer forgot, and a real kneeling apology briefly opens renewed listening.
records.L_rationale: This-time-I-will-listen acknowledges prior reception failure rather than proving it was already repaired.
records.H_rationale: Both the argument and serious attempt to hear the repeated statement occur.
records.eligibility_and_limits: An interruption follows before the disclosure; no invented completed understanding or lasting reform.

records.whole_selected_premise: Reward news redirects the apology into a noble search whose imagined highborn cues exclude the conspicuous actual street pair.
records.L_rationale: The servant’s category description interacts with the seeker’s assumptions and a corrected claim that both girls need cash.
records.H_rationale: Megumin really accepts the task while Yunyun explicitly says she is not short of money.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No performed intimate work; noble appearance stereotypes are character beliefs and the missed pair are reader-identifiable at unequal knowledge.

records.whole_selected_premise: A true claim of being known to guards launders a bad reputation into apparent status, then three real frog kills become bait for a riskier forest trip.
records.L_rationale: Truth-withheld-cause and future gratitude recruit consent to a different plan from the original plains hunt.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun contributes the kills and later receives actual 15000; she agrees to the forest after persuasion.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No five-kill bonus, full information on every danger or unconditional future obedience.

records.whole_selected_premise: Both informed mages let a cute rabbit override a received warning until meat eating and a piercing attack make the cost immediate.
records.L_rationale: Appearance, diet evidence and attack change tactical appraisal in a portable sequence.
records.H_rationale: Megumin immobilizes a rabbit while retrieving her hat and both actually flee the swarm.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The cat is safely left at the inn; no inference of rabbit harmlessness from the cute illustration or prior wording.

records.whole_selected_premise: The spent rival wins an agreement to return, then a level gain revives the other’s weak-prey proposal before multiple sounds restore flight.
records.L_rationale: Reluctant assent and a quickly revised recommendation distinguish actual stopping from a stable policy.
records.H_rationale: Mana depletion, level increase, complaint and renewed avoidance all precede the next attack.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No abundant repeat resources or goal-weakened safe continuation supplied merely by partial recovery.

records.whole_selected_premise: Nonfire defensive spells preserve the forest until imminent encirclement precedes a knowingly collateral Explosion that throws both girls unconscious.
records.L_rationale: The existing death threat, remaining magic and radius explain the choice without a special word hinge.
records.H_rationale: The danger is already immediate before the cast, unlike EXP02’s earlier pet-death choice.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not erase current acknowledged collateral or assume complete recovery from eventual waking; an unknown voice is not yet a confirmed protector.

records.whole_selected_premise: A devil rehearses a Crimson-style introduction that frightens his intended listeners into flight before he can explain his search.
records.L_rationale: Not-a-giant-goblin correction and future-child-servant grand style fail to establish shared benign intent.
records.H_rationale: Horst approaches and they flee; Megumin admits underestimating a forest devil.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No attack by Horst is actually shown in this encounter, and the unidentified child is not named to the girls.

records.whole_selected_premise: An alarming report receives a possible-friendly correction, then one doubt about Explosion endurance instantly reopens the forest challenge the caster had renounced.
records.L_rationale: The same threat is reappraised as an art-efficacy challenge; Yunyun’s direct refusal remains.
records.H_rationale: The challenge attempt and refusal are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: High-devil grave risk is not quietly relabeled ordinary companion inconvenience to fill a different model trigger.

records.whole_selected_premise: The observed workers now complete paid civil labor while the self-described autonomous traveler remains drawn to their enjoyment and neglects a precise account of pet care.
records.L_rationale: The girl reverses her earlier work stance and the narrator follows the pair’s repeated affect rather than knowing their names.
records.H_rationale: Work, apparent wages, the fall, complying with Yunyun’s look-away request and the weak cat are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The food/water question goes unanswered; no nutrition diagnosis, proof of causation or later party familiarity is imported.

records.whole_selected_premise: A money-seeking expedition joins a concrete cannot-leave-you care statement, but the recipient asks for repetition and immediately adds a reward.
records.L_rationale: Quiet concern, requested repetition and overt payment talk have different forces within the same agreement.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s accepted risk and own concern coexist with the expedition’s ordinary monetary aim.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Her donated potions are a reported gift from an unrecognized woman, not independently witnessed by Megumin.

records.whole_selected_premise: A rank taunt meets actual private restraint for group cohesion, but the friend preemptively grabs the restrained caster and creates a different quarrel.
records.L_rationale: Narrator-disclosed intent contradicts the friend’s expected pattern before the forceful intervention.
records.H_rationale: Megumin really withholds the first retaliation; unwanted restraint and painful retaliation also occur.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not label the entire exchange either untroubled maturity or a prevented chant that was never initiated; non-graphic scope.

records.whole_selected_premise: The master of overwhelming force pushes a distressed friend to handle small slimes; her real fireball needs the allegedly lesser crew to extinguish the burning tree.
records.L_rationale: Will-fight-but-stop-pushing preserves specific objection while practical help changes the crew’s appraisal.
records.H_rationale: Lightning, Fireball, fire suppression, praise and Rex’s challenge are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Useful magic is not safe whole-operation mastery, and prior consent to a quest is not permission to push.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposedly sufficient hero returns badly hurt while the newest level-one priest is reported to have all skills; beauty suddenly energizes the search.
records.L_rationale: The receptionist corrects the low-level-few-skills inference before the crowd’s selective response.
records.H_rationale: Reports alter available help under an actual expedition failure and outside-reinforcement shortage.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The hero duel and Beldia’s destination are not directly observed; low level does not determine every acquired skill.

records.whole_selected_premise: The searcher compensates a dirty worker’s contested wage claim and rejects the very blue-haired woman who fits the search clue.
records.L_rationale: Self-asserted loss, coworker protest and holy-image expectation carry different evidential weights.
records.H_rationale: The payment and mistaken dismissal are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not certify the claimed original 10000 merely because the payer hands it over or hide the earlier Axis clue.

records.whole_selected_premise: An unexplained locked-room guest repeatedly ignores a name request, then a sacred mission shrinks to a loan and a paid search makes the unwilling host accept.
records.L_rationale: Prestigious address, unanswered entry question and abrupt yes-to-payment expose changing conversational purposes.
records.H_rationale: Cecily’s unwanted intrusion, Megumin’s resistance and the accepted paid task are literal.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Later Yunyun Unlock does not explain Cecily’s earlier entry; no completed divine loan or unlimited bodily permission.

records.whole_selected_premise: The priest-seeker rejects beer and grievance as unholy but gets useful help by refusing the priest’s proposed church destruction and honestly explaining the need.
records.L_rationale: A direct refusal, apology and specific request repair access after Cecily’s hostile framing.
records.H_rationale: Megumin actually declines the destructive request and the Eris clergy offer a possible lead.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No church Explosion occurs and possible orphanage presence is not confirmed by this suggestion.

records.whole_selected_premise: A helpful priest’s window is broken by the companion who wanted a holy itinerary, and a blue-haired charity recipient is discounted because she should be a volunteer.
records.L_rationale: The narrator’s normative should-be schema rejects a concrete incongruent clue.
records.H_rationale: Cecily’s vandalism and Megumin’s rebuke remain actual; the helper’s testimony is attributed.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The later priest identity does not make these cues absent at the earlier search.

records.whole_selected_premise: A cemetery prank elicits genuine shielding before retaliation, then two promised fighters both run from an unidentified presence and dispute the unpaid task boundary.
records.L_rationale: The person-search-not-guard correction limits the accepted role after a mutual countdown fails to produce combat.
records.H_rationale: Fear, shielding, running and the boundary argument are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The reported pale woman is not a locally confirmed attacking undead; no Turn Undead is acquired because the role suggests it.

records.whole_selected_premise: The hopeful applicant waits all night as others leave, while the late drinker later claims the narrator was the one worried about her.
records.L_rationale: Just-a-little-longer repetition explains the wait, and blame redirection contradicts the narrator’s actual account.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s costly waiting and Megumin’s continued accepted task coexist with Cecily’s self-serving account.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Waiting is not proof of recruitment success, and Megumin does not know all interlude conversations.

records.whole_selected_premise: A rough crew apologizes, supplies real ambush protection and invites the mage whose sleep spell captures prey, while her friend again refuses help as training.
records.L_rationale: The actual invitation follows demonstrated work, so panic is not absence of demand.
records.H_rationale: Terry blocks a real attack, the group coordinates and Yunyun receives an offer.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Mages’ initial retreat is role-specific risk judgment, not generalized cowardice; accepting the party is not yet shown here.

records.whole_selected_premise: An ignored taunt yields to a target concern that the arriving devil confirms in the opposite way: the caught beast is merely an ordinary beginner-killer.
records.L_rationale: The narrator explicitly sets temper aside; Horst’s correction defeats the proposed prey identity.
records.H_rationale: Horst knocks three people unconscious and recognizes the wrong target.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Megumin says she cannot determine how he struck; do not invent a known attack mechanism or credit the mistaken hunt as correct.

records.whole_selected_premise: The wanted master is finally joined to the pet, and the devil’s contract assurances try to turn a coercive mass threat into a clean exchange.
records.L_rationale: Our-pet plea, substitute-cat proposal and never-break-contract claim have opposed practical purposes.
records.H_rationale: Megumin’s recognition and refusal of interference occur under actual conditional threats.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actor doctrine does not prove a completed contract, pet assent or guaranteed benign transfer.

records.whole_selected_premise: The city-level threat briefly makes pet transfer thinkable, then the sight of unfamiliar happy workers makes fleeing’s first victims concrete.
records.L_rationale: A conditional transfer proposal and an unspoken tightening grip show different stages of appraisal before the next commitment.
records.H_rationale: The girls transport the injured crew and Megumin actually anticipates bystander costs before resolving to fight.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not grant prior friendship with the workers or erase mixed pride/care motives after the later victory.

records.whole_selected_premise: A warning about devil trust becomes a dispute over lonely and gullible nicknames, with the danger still unresolved.
records.L_rationale: A fake promotion in labels reinstates the same insult rather than accepting the recipient’s request.
records.H_rationale: The argument and forceful neck contact are actual, analyzed without graphic detail.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No clinical diagnosis or assumption that a joke removes the friend’s objection.

records.whole_selected_premise: Never-said-I-accepted carefully differs from never-considered, and a friend label recruits company while the friend explicitly rejects all-purpose obedience.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun’s rival correction and admission of happiness preserve ambivalence beside a clear boundary.
records.H_rationale: Megumin adopts the fight and stops the departing friend by her cloak.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Earlier transfer deliberation remains exact; valued friendship does not authorize every imposed cost.

records.whole_selected_premise: A mysterious fund-raising plan is misread as intimate work, while the actual tactic is a deliberately gratifying older-sister address.
records.L_rationale: Euphemistic suspicion is corrected by the concrete request, and the recipient overinterprets a house fantasy before clarification.
records.H_rationale: Megumin really requests an advance and Cecily really enjoys the address.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No intimate work is performed; no household or unrestricted-contact agreement follows.

records.whole_selected_premise: A dangerous mission’s generous guarantee produces sincere tears just before the trusted bag reveals stones and a blank prize slip.
records.L_rationale: Warm trust language earns actual belief before the prop contradicts its ostensible purpose.
records.H_rationale: Cecily really authors a prank and Megumin really feels reassured then retaliates.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual 10000000 payment at this moment; the contemporary comic is the same prank, not an independent second act.

records.whole_selected_premise: The fooled recipient hides a humiliating prank behind a corrected misunderstanding, but the next bag really contains gold.
records.L_rationale: The denial of intimate work leaves the exact source of tears unspoken for face reasons; later actual coins change the material state.
records.H_rationale: Cecily’s explanation and actual advance enable purchases.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not carry the earlier stones forward as the current funds or invent the exact intervening transfer scene.

records.whole_selected_premise: The novice swallows pride to recruit guards, yet former companions refuse precisely because they know the friendly-fire problem from experience.
records.L_rationale: Because-we-have-teamed-up rejects the assumption that familiarity should secure support.
records.H_rationale: The offers, concrete refusals and refusal to risk untrained admirers are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not merely irrational art prejudice; do not name an unspecified former partner or assume a willing recovery carrier.

records.whole_selected_premise: A purchased Hide scroll seems to solve the encounter until its refraction limits matter, while the cat is tied for a scent decoy then actually entrusted elsewhere.
records.L_rationale: Material concealment, scent, target geometry and a separate care provider explain the plan.
records.H_rationale: Megumin acknowledges pet attachment and causal responsibility, unties the cat and arranges Cecily’s care.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No pet assent to tying, invisible mana or proven undetectability; current care does not rewrite EXP02’s sacrifice willingness.

records.whole_selected_premise: A priest’s real healing story is interrupted as irrelevant before it can correct reputation, and the rival’s night outing has an undisclosed independent purpose.
records.L_rationale: Repeated name/address negotiation reaches a bounded compromise, while come-with-you is explicitly declined.
records.H_rationale: Pet-care acceptance, refusal to teach a new trick and Yunyun’s independent departure occur.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed drinking episode or unconditional obedience; reader only learns the outing’s purpose later.

records.whole_selected_premise: The fearless image hides insomnia; the apparently sleeping listener hears genuine admiration and a concrete flaw she admits she overlooked.
records.L_rationale: The confession’s audience assumption is false, but its Hide/chant warning is actually received.
records.H_rationale: Megumin is afraid and awake, Yunyun enters by Unlock and the plan’s mana leak is a real acknowledged omission.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not infer Yunyun’s exact unseen facial expression or that the original plan was independently complete.

records.whole_selected_premise: The shy rival independently recruits the crew, declares her best friend and imposes Sleep to replace a plan she expects to lose.
records.L_rationale: A caring reason and apology accompany an actual unilateral disabling act, not a mutually negotiated change.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun has real agency, tactical judgment and protective coercion.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No overnight daily Explosion is performed after Sleep; affection does not retrospectively give Megumin consent.

records.whole_selected_premise: The awakened hero first resents losing the best part, then receives the previously interrupted healer’s contribution and a blessing that genuinely calms her.
records.L_rationale: The older-sister address changes from an instrumental cash tactic to a voluntary grateful farewell.
records.H_rationale: Cecily supplies partial functional healing and a real blessing act; Megumin’s fear lessens.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The chant’s exact magical buff is uncertain, and barely combat-ready is not full health. Mixed motives remain.

records.whole_selected_premise: A hidden spectator delays joining a winning fight for clan face, while the existing group actually spends supplies and uses its own agreed F signal.
records.L_rationale: The code works for its informed recipients but leaves the new hidden observer outside the agreement.
records.H_rationale: Manatite, Cancel scroll, guarding, a broken arm and coordinated preparation are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The observed portrait composite does not mean Yunyun knows Megumin is awake; the inserted voiced-い glyph is separately read.

records.whole_selected_premise: Flash blinds the uninformed helper while the eye-independent devil remains effective, and a thrown weapon buys the last mage time.
records.L_rationale: Different sensory mechanisms and communication access explain the reversed tactical result.
records.H_rationale: The hidden observer is blinded, allies fall and Rex actually intervenes before being struck.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Horst’s virtual-body mechanism is his explanation plus local observed immunity, not unrestricted future immunity.

records.whole_selected_premise: The academically informed mage makes normal Paralysis work with a potion, then discovers its indiscriminate area also immobilizes herself.
records.L_rationale: The potion’s exact indiscriminate wording exposes an operational caveat after a real successful target effect.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun knows ordinary ineffectiveness, uses enhancement and suffers the actual self-effect.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No blind elementary-spell mistake; probable father-made product remains Megumin’s inference. A suggested ceasefire is not a completed agreement.

records.whole_selected_premise: The self-styled passing great mage selects a dramatic entrance and publicly spends her friend’s private affection despite repeated explicit pleas to stop.
records.L_rationale: Quoted private language changes force under enemy and peer audience; embarrassment and refusal are the recipient’s actual responses.
records.H_rationale: The disclosure and face cost remain real even though it accompanies useful rescue preparation.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No universal dignity-protective rule; the hyperbolic embarrassment wish is not literal death intent or freely agreed disclosure.

records.whole_selected_premise: Friendship rhetoric and grand charging secure the finishing moment while the opponent discloses two earlier attackers and a construction worker already weakened him.
records.L_rationale: The final complaint about this town reframes a heroic duel as accumulated odd people and provider costs.
records.H_rationale: Megumin really charges and fires; Horst’s earlier encounters are attributed reports learned only now.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not backdate this weakness into Megumin’s original plan, grant independent whole-operation control or treat claimed backup lives as witnessed resurrection.

records.whole_selected_premise: The triumphant finisher leaves almost everyone needing stretchers, then gives the bounty to those who made the finish possible and owns her part in the danger.
records.L_rationale: Explicit I-was-not-the-one-who-drove-him-that-far corrects simple winner entitlement.
records.H_rationale: Defeat, depletion, transport burden and actual transfer of reward coexist with pleasure in the hero role.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Helpful result does not erase the immobile friends’ exposure or establish full aftercare and final settlement of every debt.

records.whole_selected_premise: The erratic cleric leaves to gain useful skill and a higher position after real healing help, but her fond departure hug still meets a release request.
records.L_rationale: Self-interested advancement and affectionate address coexist with a specific physical boundary.
records.H_rationale: A decision and departure occur; useful healing is neither invented nor comprehensive absolution.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No already completed training, appointment or fulfilled goddess-loan mission; non-graphic unwanted contact retained.

records.whole_selected_premise: The rival leaves partly from embarrassment but chiefly to surpass the friend she cannot surpass while following her, and finally receives a serious no-tricks future promise.
records.L_rationale: Grand rival self-positioning follows exposed affection without canceling it; the future skill condition limits the proposed duel.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun chooses departure and Megumin accepts a prospective contest.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Advanced magic and the duel are not performed; Megumin’s nearly-all-wins boast is not an independently counted record.

records.whole_selected_premise: A two-devil conqueror is still hungry because she gave away rewards and expected glory to guarantee ordinary employability.
records.L_rationale: The grand self-introduction is punctured by the plain hunger declaration and acknowledged overconfident income forecast.
records.H_rationale: Both gifts and material deprivation are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Generosity, pride and prediction error coexist; no permanent indifference to money or unseen loan repayment.

records.whole_selected_premise: An elite group finally offers an appropriate role, but the desperate applicant releases the recruiter and chooses the town she likes before regretting a missed meal.
records.L_rationale: Attractive private appraisal and the small liking admission qualify the public low-level excuse; the meal regret follows an actual declined offer.
records.H_rationale: Rex’s offer, planned capital move and Megumin’s refusal are genuine choices.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not every recruitment failed or rejected her. No assertion of perpetual immobility or rejection of all advancement.

records.whole_selected_premise: The grand applicant approaches an alarming self-praising notice, finally recognizes the missing priest and chooses the familiar pair’s apparent joy while staging cool indifference.
records.L_rationale: The mismatched advertisement and performed indifference are openly explained by a hungry narrator whose actual affiliation motive includes enjoyment.
records.H_rationale: Recognition, approach and signature introduction complete the prequel’s altered appraisal of Axel.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Later party acceptance, named intimacy and future agreements are not supplied by this ending.

records.whole_selected_premise: The lonely girl calls her friend a rival while recognizing that the allegedly shorter-tempered girl is comparatively social.
records.L_rationale: Self-repair between friendship and rivalry regulates self-presentation without erasing affection.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s first-person appraisal supplies her own motives.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No narrator omniscience about every inner state or single fixed relationship label.

records.whole_selected_premise: Would-be recruiters look pleased at the notice, then the delighted applicant’s eye contact makes them withdraw.
records.L_rationale: The recipient reads a happy gaze as threatening, a pragmatic mismatch resolved on the next page.
records.H_rationale: She really hides and the groups really withdraw.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not absence of interested recruiters; do not assign deliberate intimidation before the staff correction.

records.whole_selected_premise: A guild worker explains that excitement makes the applicant’s red eyes look angry, and an apology follows the received correction.
records.L_rationale: The same visible signal has opposite intended and received affect; explicit explanation changes available knowledge.
records.H_rationale: The complaint, Yunyun’s excitement explanation and apology are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Racial physiology is fictional context, not nonliteral behavioral license or proof the social issue is permanently cured.

records.whole_selected_premise: The suspiciously older self-declared thirteen-year-old is startled when the anxious girl offers conversation without joining a party.
records.L_rationale: A limited just-talk offer is distinct from the visitor’s broader solicitation and from the age performance.
records.H_rationale: An actual bounded social offer surprises its recipient.
records.eligibility_and_limits: This page ends before the main narrator’s reported meal; no second event or verified age.

records.whole_selected_premise: A legend of the youngest dragon knight circulates among adventurers whose faces remain unknown to the listener’s imagined hero.
records.L_rationale: Reported reputation and unknown facial identity let admiration coexist with failed recognition.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun overhears the gossip and assesses a recruitment opening.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Gossip is not a newly verified complete Dust biography or a separately witnessed dragon-knight exploit.

records.whole_selected_premise: The supposedly passive girl actually initiates recruitment, but the party’s existing women hiss and she retreats before the boy can give a refusal.
records.L_rationale: Anticipated recipient hostility and actual women’s intervention shape the withdrawal; no boy answer is supplied.
records.H_rationale: Own initiative and social inhibition coexist.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not say he personally rejected her or that she never tried an approach.

records.whole_selected_premise: A known-dangerous sect still offers the conversation the applicant lacks, while onlookers object to raising her hopes.
records.L_rationale: Listening is valued despite recognized sect risk, and observers name the ethical cost of the promise.
records.H_rationale: A blue-robed woman offers to listen and produces a form.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Woman’s identity is not supplied by robe alone; a form is not completed conversion.

records.whole_selected_premise: The easy recruit sincerely agrees, startling the recruiter who had promised friends; a later interlude reveals the sect refused her.
records.L_rationale: Unusually serious uptake defeats the normal manipulative script and exposes the recipient’s vulnerability.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s declaration and the woman’s shock are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed registration; later refusal corrects any conversion inference, and the protagonist does not witness this exchange.

records.whole_selected_premise: Rejected even by the sect, the aspiring independent traveler receives a self-appointed mentor whose reassurance costs her beer.
records.L_rationale: A proverb and one-problem-at-a-time promise create an advisory role before any useful solution.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun actually buys drinks but refuses to drink because she is young.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No alcohol use by her, sound expertise or completed friendship merely from the advisory claim.

records.whole_selected_premise: The promised adviser is drunk after an hour and replaces actual recruitment help with sexualized clothing advice.
records.L_rationale: Unsolicited adult advice changes the purpose and violates the actual young listener’s boundaries.
records.H_rationale: The drinking, expense and unwelcome remarks remain literal, discussed non-graphically.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No evidence that she adopts the advice or agrees to the sexualized frame.

records.whole_selected_premise: Her angry eyes and table strike finally fit the fear others previously misread, and the frightened adviser calls the conduct a test.
records.L_rationale: A joke/test reclassification follows a genuine angry response, not independent evidence of a planned lesson.
records.H_rationale: She protests and the man retreats rhetorically.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not replace the earlier excited-eye explanation with a universal anger meaning or certify his excuse.

records.whole_selected_premise: A demand for a real solution ends in a money-for-friends joke that the listener seriously accepts, again startling the adviser.
records.L_rationale: Literal practical uptake exposes how far the speaker’s flippant proposal is from the listener’s actual need.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun grabs his collar and considers the advertisement.
records.eligibility_and_limits: 胸ぐら is collar; no groping, completed paid-friend contract or actual new party supplied.

records.whole_selected_premise: Two weeks after choosing a solo path, the would-be chief says rapid solo advancement justifies passing through two towns without a party.
records.L_rationale: The self-justifying account prepares an explicit retraction on the next page.
records.H_rationale: Travel and retained ambition are actual first-person facts.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A stated rationale is not the only motive or proof she enjoys solitude.

records.whole_selected_premise: The proud solo rationale is immediately admitted to be a lie: she wants even conversation, and a woman offers baked sweets.
records.L_rationale: The abrupt self-correction separates aspirational independence from actual company desire.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s admitted wish and the traveler’s concrete kindness are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not an achieved party, permanent self-knowledge or mere helplessness; she chose her route.

records.whole_selected_premise: A grand Crimson introduction meets a kindly woman who finds the names odd and waives the formal introduction.
records.L_rationale: Performed ethnic self-positioning is met by a different conversational convention, not a hostile challenge.
records.H_rationale: The woman removes her hood and responds to Yunyun’s eyes and name.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Red short hair and yellow eyes support reader comparison, not a proper identity the girl has yet learned.

records.whole_selected_premise: One girl’s still-revisitable friend separation contrasts with a woman grieving subordinates who have left this world.
records.L_rationale: The correction distinguishes two kinds of parting while retaining both recipients’ felt loss.
records.H_rationale: The woman actually reports grief and Yunyun responds sympathetically.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The exact dead identities, permanent extinction and supernatural rebirth are not independently witnessed here.

records.whole_selected_premise: A strong traveler actually offers company, but the lonely girl declines the Arcanretia destination because of her earlier experience.
records.L_rationale: A rare invitation is refused on a concrete route preference rather than lack of social desire.
records.H_rationale: Actual opportunity, refusal and the woman’s own stay plan preserve both actors’ agency.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed joint journey or claim nobody offered to travel with her.

records.whole_selected_premise: A sect’s blanket attribution of its own food-water disaster to the demon army shocks a woman who mutters that the town’s plan was meant for later.
records.L_rationale: Public blame and an involuntary timing correction give the reader unequal information from a startled listener.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun reports the accepted accusation and the woman demands details.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not proof Arnes caused the powder accident, that a future operation occurs or that Yunyun understands the woman’s hidden connection.

records.whole_selected_premise: A rare invitation becomes a lifelong remembrance vow, startling the woman into clarifying her casual interest and urging friendship as well as training.
records.L_rationale: The disproportionate relational force is explicitly negotiated by the recipient before a kindly parting.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun really apologizes and the woman actually offers advice.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A demon-king warning is not a proven prophecy or a permanent friendship contract.

records.whole_selected_premise: A familiar lonely-demon-king fable turns into self-reassurance through a cascading friend/rival label, then the speaker realizes she forgot her new acquaintance’s name.
records.L_rationale: The repeated revised relation labels and delayed omitted-name realization shape the written closing cadence.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun recalls a nested story and resolves to surpass her friend.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The fable is not another present-world battle; chiefship is future, and the unnamed woman remains unnamed to Yunyun.
